**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 05:18
- [FACT] The user was spending an average of 3 hours a day scrolling through social media feeds before taking a break from it.
- [CHANGE] The user has recently taken a break from social media.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is trying to stay productive and focused but is struggling to manage their time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on recognizing the issue with social media usage and wanting to make a change.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended several tools and apps to help the user stay focused and avoid procrastination, including:
  - Freedom: Blocks distracting websites and apps across all devices (Free trial, then subscription).
  - StayFocusd: A Chrome extension that limits access to specific websites (Free).
  - RescueTime: Tracks how time is spent on devices, providing insights (Free, with premium features).
  - Moment: Tracks screen time and helps set goals to reduce it (Free, with premium features).
  - Todoist: A task management app for setting priorities, deadlines, and reminders (Free, with premium features).
  - Trello: A visual project management tool using boards, lists, and cards (Free, with premium features).
  - Evernote: A note-taking app with task management features (Free, with premium features).
  - Pomodoro timers: Tools like Pomofocus, Pomodoro Timer, or Tomato Timer for focused work sessions (Free).
  - Noisli: A background noise generator to help concentrate (Free).
  - Focus@Will: A music service designed to help concentration (Free trial, then subscription).
  - Forest: A gamified productivity app that grows a virtual forest as the user stays focused (Free, with in-app purchases).
  - Stay on Task: An app that helps stay focused on a single task (Free, with in-app purchases).
  - Cold Turkey: A mobile app that blocks distracting websites and apps (Free trial, then subscription).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided additional tips for productivity, including scheduling breaks, setting goals and rewards, creating a conducive environment, and prioritizing self-care.
- [USER] The user expressed interest in setting up a daily routine to help stay on track.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested a daily routine framework, including:
  - Morning Routine (60-90 minutes): Consistent wake-up time, morning exercise, meditation and mindfulness, breakfast and planning.
  - Work Sessions (90-120 minutes each, with breaks): Focus on a single task, work without distractions, and take breaks.
  - Evening Routine (60-90 minutes): Wrap up work, relaxation and self-care, prepare for tomorrow.
